page_title: LUT 0-1 TOT | Luton v Tottenham Hotspur 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+2' Alejo Veliz (Tottenham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Dejan Kulusevski.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pedro Porro (Tottenham) takes it short.
90' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
89' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
86' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 2:4.
82' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Ben Davies (Tottenham) replaces Destiny Udogie.
81' Substitution. Ross Barkley (Luton) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Tom Lockyer walks off.
80' The ball goes behind for a corner. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Alfie Doughty (Luton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Good work from Luton as they win a corner.
76' Ange Postecoglou decides to make a substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Emerson Royal (Tottenham) will replace Heung-Min Son.

75' The most active player in today's match is definitely James Maddison (Tottenham). He's trying to be on the ball as much as possible and you can literally see the enthusiasm in his play. He keeps exchanging some one touch passes and waits for the right moment to send a killer pass. What a player!
74' The ball possession at the moment is 28:72.
74' The ball goes out of play. Luton are awarded a corner kick.
73' CLOSE! Alfie Doughty (Luton) shows off his amazing skills with a solo run to the edge of the box before fashioning a shot that goes inches wide of the left post!
73' Luton win a corner.
71' The resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton) is cleared by the defence.
68' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.

68' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a low shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
67' The substitution is prepared. Cauley Woodrow (Luton) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Elijah Adebayo.
67' Today's match ends for Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu who will be replaced by Tahith Chong (Luton).
66' Rob Edwards has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Luke Berry (Luton) replacing Jacob Brown.
64' Carlton Morris (Luton) meets a cross from Alfie Doughty, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
62' So close! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.

60' Carlton Morris (Luton) unleashes a promising shot towards the left side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Guglielmo Vicario thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
59' It will be a substitution. Teden Mengi (Luton) is ready to enter the pitch as Mads Juel Andersen walks off.
57' Mads Juel Andersen (Luton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

57' Good chance for Alfie Doughty (Luton) as he latched on to a cross on the edge of the box and blasted the ball towards the net! It flew wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
55' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) picks up an injury.
52' 0 - 1 Goal! Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from James Maddison, then sends the ball inside the left post. 0:1.
52' Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
52' James Maddison (Tottenham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Tottenham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
51' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

47' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Richarlison is replaced by Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) receives a second yellow card and is sent off.

45+2' James Maddison (Tottenham) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
44' Carlton Morris (Luton) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
41' Carlton Morris (Luton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
40' The Elijah Adebayo (Luton) turns away in celebration as the ball hits the net, but his joy is short-lived as referee John Brooks rules it out for a foul.
38' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) will miss the next game.
38' Yves Bissouma (Tottenham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' The number of shots on goal at present is 0:3.
34' Carlton Morris (Luton) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.

32' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
32' John Brooks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marvelous Nakamba (Luton).
31' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guglielmo Vicario, who smothers the ball.
30' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner.

30' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Thomas Kaminski pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
28' Flag up against Elijah Adebayo (Luton). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
25' The ball is out of play. Luton win a corner kick.
21' Marvelous Nakamba (Luton) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
19' Tom Lockyer (Luton) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

19' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Richarlison (Tottenham) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
18' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
17' James Maddison (Tottenham) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.

16' Wasted effort! Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
13' John Brooks blows for a foul after Jacob Brown (Luton) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

10' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
8' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) runs onto a defence-splitting pass and rifles in shot that zooms just past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Luton.
4' The possession of the ball – 9:91.

3' Richarlison (Tottenham) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
2' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Tottenham will kick the game off.
John Brooks got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
